notes.title: Leaderboard and Speedrun Submissions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068236/b35ae219be0d60364e4fbb48f09a6c72c905a838.png[/img]

The demo for Disposition reveals your ranking on the timed leaderboard at the end of your run. This feature has garnered some attention from the speedrunning community, prompting discussions about adding the Disposition Demo to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Disposition]speedrun.com[/url].

[previewyoutube=civHQsEHvUg;full][/previewyoutube]
Since Disposition was developed with speedrunning in mind, watching speedrun playthroughs offers us crucial insights into the player experience. We encourage you to submit your runs to help us enhance the game!

[url=https://www.speedrun.com/Disposition][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068236/92f02b75401106672d32c9e78d85b6efb782da3c.png[/img][/url]

Currently, there are only a few runners, but we plan to make some adjustments before Steam Next Fest in hopes of attracting more runner scores.

[h2]DOWNLOAD DEMO & WISHLIST DISPOSITION👇[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051480/Disposition/?curator_clanid=45088963

notes.title: THROWING MECHANIC ADDED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068236/1cdfd6723cdffd9483bf4fec2c84dab35d2c49e7.png[/img]

In "[b]Disposition[/b]," your task is to position objects accurately, and since you are being timed, speed is crucial. We've introduced a throwing feature to help with this. Simply click and hold in the direction you wish to place the object, and it will be lobbed accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068236/d623691b791331eb58a7daba169aa97e77be46e5.gif[/img]
You could even "Put the fries in the bag". 🍟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068236/e85deeb8011311bc17508cf8bf3b795ebc22a8c3.gif[/img]

[h2]WISHLIST DISPOSITION HERE 👇[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051480/Disposition/
